newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes 0.09 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes 0.09 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis stock exchange index on Thursday closed down 0.09 percent compared with the previous session, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 481.32 points, down from 481.77 points on Wednesday.
Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing dropped 1.16 dinar to 30.84 dinars.
Real estate firm Societe Immobiliere et de Participation SIMPAR fell 0.7 dinar to 23.6.
Detergent firm SPCD slid 0.48 dinar to 35.02.
Banque Nationale Agricole fell 0.85 dinar to 27.38 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat was down 0.46 dinar to 16.49. BTEI bank declined 0.14 dinar to 22.3 dinars.
Investment fund Tuninvest -SICAF was up 0.2 dinar to 12.2 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels rose 0.2 dinar to 11. Airline Tunis Air advanced 0.18 dinar to 23.88 dinars with 16,933 shares changing hands.
Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel was up 0.14 dinar to 11.3 dinars.
Total volume was 3.31 million dinars against 1.82 million over the previous session.
Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 1.39 million dinars.
